correctness.rationale: The stated renewal-count coefficients follow by an explicit small-s Laplace expansion of the Lomax density, monotone density Tauberian inversion of the completely monotone renewal density, factorial-count convolution and the equilibrium pair-intensity identity. The Itô cosine decomposition reduces physical displacement to a nonzero multiple of the reset count with L2 error O(t), so covariance errors are lower order for 1<alpha<2; the sine counterpart has zero conditional reward mean and O(t) transverse variance. All assumptions, powers and constant factors were re-derived, and checker.py reproduced independent reward quadratures and finite diagnostic count simulations. The quantitative constants were checked at alpha=3/2; simulations are not presented as proofs.

value.rationale: This is a natural unresolved physical transport regime in the literature-led model: infinite-variance renewal intervals turn otherwise diffusive longitudinal fluctuations into t^(3-alpha) superdiffusion without inducing the same perpendicular growth. The exact coefficient ratio 1/(alpha-1) quantifies a nontrivial dependence on equilibrium versus fresh observation initiation, relevant to experiment preparation. It is a structural and measurable separation, not a routine finite numerical recalculation; no unsupported broad extension is claimed.
